label: Opening Hook
text: This 100-foot temple was not built from the ground up—it was carved out of a single mountain from top to bottom.
title: File:Small temple in side the Kailasa Temple, Ellora, cave (16).jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Over 200,000 tons of solid basalt rock were chiseled away with hand tools Carved vertically from top to bottom with zero room for architectural error Features intricate life-sized elephants, multi-story courtyards, and monolithic obelisks Built in the 8th century under King Krishna I of the Rashtrakuta dynasty Legend claims it was finished in just 18 years, an impossible feat for hand chisels
title: File:Premises of Cave no 16, Ellora, Maharashtra, India 46.jpg
